It thereby encourages you to sell at a lower price or less margin. This way u loose net money in the sale, since sell when price is lower too , but Groww makes money on brokerages. Effectively u are losing money. Since most Groww users are not exactly regular traders, we dont keep track of the exact price we bought, and Groww cheats its customers this way!!
